intent: Observe start screen and find AI puzzle generation option
expectation: Start screen has both a standard test button and an AI generation option

intent: Click 'Generate a fresh test with AI' to trigger AI puzzle creation
expectation: Clicking this will show a loading/generating state while AI creates new puzzles

args.name: Generate a fresh test with AI

intent: Answer Q1 (analogy: two triangles:one triangle :: two circles:?) by selecting option D (one circle)
expectation: Selecting D highlights it and enables the Next button

intent: Click Next to advance to Q2
expectation: Q2 will load with a new puzzle

intent: Answer Q2 sequence puzzle — select Option A (square at 270°, continuing the rotation sequence)
expectation: Option A highlights and Next activates

args.name: Option A — 1 outline medium square, rotated 270°

expectation: Q3 loads with a new puzzle type

intent: Answer Q3 odd-one-out — select B (4 solid diamonds, only solid-fill item)
expectation: B highlights, Next activates, then clicking Next loads Q4

args.name: Option B — 4 solid small diamonds, rotated 45°

intent: Answer Q4 analogy (4 half squares:4 half squares rotated 315 :: 4 half triangles:?) with Option A (4 half triangles rotated 315)
expectation: Option A highlights, then Next loads Q5

args.name: Option A — 4 half large triangles, rotated 315°

intent: Observe Q5 (grid matrix puzzle) and note the layout before answering
expectation: A 3x3 grid with hexagons; bottom-right shows 'See results' button
